ChainSecurity | Blockchain Security Engineer | Full-time | INTERNS , HYBRID/REMOTE, Zurich, Switzerland | VISA possible | https://chainsecurity.com/

ChainSecurity is a young and innovative cybersecurity company that operates in the blockchain and cryptocurrency space. Our mission is to make the blockchain space secure and trustworthy for people, companies, and governments alike. We are proud of our security experts from the renowned universities ETH Zurich, EPFL Lausanne and others.

We are trusted by 100+ blockchain companies and established corporations with security audits and services. We have secured complex systems for top blockchain clients, such as decentralized finance (DeFi) projects, and multinational organizations, such as banks and industrial consortia. A ChainSecurity Auditor will review the most complex blockchain projects to find vulnerabilities which no-one else can. By using state of the art tools, expert knowledge and a deep understanding of the fundamentals, we secure projects handling billions, often forming the foundation in the new paradigm of an open financial system.

Your Responsibilities:

* Work directly with the developers of the most successful teams in the blockchain industry to audit their code and secure their products

* Contribute to our security tools and create new ones in collaboration with our internal research team

* Conduct security research and publish your findings Requirements:

* Strong background in software engineering, focused on security relevant areas and most importantly being able to reason about complex code

* Experience with penetration testing, vulnerability scanning, threat modeling or similar is a plus

* Good knowledge of cryptography

* Proficiency with Linux and Git

* Good written communication skills

* Fluent in OOP programming language

Bonus Points:

* Formal Verification, White Box, Vulnerability Scanning

* Solid Blockchain Knowledge

* Consensus Algorithms

Join us here: https://www.chainsecurity.com/jobs/blockchain-security-engin...

Questions about the role? Contact: jobs@chainsecurity.com

Vestwell | Staff Software Engineer | HYBRID - NYC, New York; Scottsdale, AZ; Austin, TX; King of Prussia, PA | https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/vestwell/jobs/7734017003 | $185K - $200K base + bonus & equity

I'm the hiring manager for this role, which is for an IC tech lead. Please see the full job description for details, but I'm looking for someone who is comfortable leading engineering discovery and working with Product on roadmap planning within the API payroll integrations space. The most important thing in this role will be driving your own pace and taking projects from inception to completion. A successful candidate will be good at working efficiently without many hard deadlines or micromanagement. We also want someone who has strong systems design experience and good technical leadership skills. In terms of tech stack, it's mostly Python and Typescript, including nest.js

Our interview process is pretty straightforward. There's a phone screen with our recruiter, then a culture fit/qualifying interview with my boss, a technical interview with a real-world problem (no leetcode), and finally a cross-functional team interview with myself and another engineering leader at my company. We move pretty quickly and aim to keep the process respectful of everyone's time. Happy to answer any questions here! If you'd like to apply, please email recruiting [at] vestwell [dot] com with your resume.

Prolific Machines | Senior Software Platform Engineer | On-site mostly (Emeryville, CA) | Full-time | $160k–$210k + equity

We use light to control how living cells produce therapeutic proteins — optogenetic cell engineering, custom illumination hardware, and real-time ML bioprocess control — to drive down cost and scale up production of next-generation therapies.

With our technology scaling from the lab to the real world of biomanufacturing, we're now hiring a foundational software engineer to build the platform tying together our hardware, firmware, cloud, and internal tooling — high ownership over architecture and direction. This is a systems role across the hardware/software boundary (not web/SaaS), working directly with embedded, mechanical, data, and even bioprocess engineers.

Looking for: strong systems thinking; Python + one of TS/Go/Rust; cloud-connected services; comfort interfacing and debugging software against hardware (serial, TCP/IP); Linux. MS + 5 yrs or BS + 7 yrs. Bonus: Industrial IoT (MQTT Sparkplug B, OPC UA, SCADA/MES), regulated-industry data integrity (21 CFR Part 11, GAMP 5), or embedded C/C++.

Apply: https://jobs.lever.co/prolific-machines/6d71f9d0-7248-4449-8...

Happy to answer questions: matt dot fay at prolific dash machines dot com.

comment_text.value:
focal vc | Head of Tech & AI | Remote/Onsite/Hybrid (US) | Includes meaningful carry

full description: hiring.focal.vc

---

focal leads inception rounds in exceptional technical founders - often before the company is obvious, before consensus forms, before datasets show a trace.

We're now hiring a founding technical leader to build the software, data, and AI systems that help us see earlier, decide better, act faster, and compound what we learn across every opportunity and portfolio company.

This is NOT an internal AI tools role. This IS a founder role. You own the proprietary intelligence layer - the system that shapes how we source, decide, support, learn, and execute.

We're looking for someone we'd back as a technical founder, but whose obsession is building the machine behind many companies rather than just one.

Details: - Carry: In Fund II and every future fund you're part of. Startup equity is one bet on one outcome. Carry is participation in every company we back, across every fund, for as long as you're here. Grants layer over time and your upside compounds. Exact % shared with qualified finalists. - Cash comp: Commensurate with experience and impact (~$175k-$250k base) - Additional benefits: 100% paid healthcare, 401(k), 6 weeks PTO, 3 months paid parental leave - Budget: For tools, compute, office needs, and experimentation - Setup: High trust, low process. You have wide autonomy over how you work, we care first and foremost about impact.

Apply: Send hiring@focal.vc your LinkedIn (and X if you have it) along with the thing you've built in recent months you're most proud of and why. We look for evidence of taste, systems thinking, and judgment.

Full post: hiring.focal.vc

Karhuno Group / https://DearHiringManager.io | Full-Stack Developer | REMOTE (US only) | Full-time

DearHiringManager.io is an early-stage SaaS product that helps job seekers find the real decision-maker behind a job opening.

A user pastes a job post URL, and the system identifies the likely future manager or team lead, plus their work email and LinkedIn profile.

We are looking for a full-stack developer to help us improve and grow the product.

You will work on: * The web app * Job post parsing and company data * Logic for identifying likely decision-makers * Contact enrichment API integrations * AI prompts and structured outputs * User flows, credits, payments, saved results, and reliability

Stack/experience: * JavaScript or TypeScript * React, Next.js, or similar * Backend APIs and databases * Third-party API integrations * SaaS basics: auth, payments, limits * Nice to have: OpenAI APIs, Supabase, Vercel, Stripe, Resend, scraping/enrichment tools, recruiting or job board products

This is a hands-on role on a live early-stage product with real users. You will work directly with the founder and have a lot of ownership.

Apply: lars@dearhiringmanager.io

Please send a short note about yourself and links to things you have built.

comment_text.value:
Quin | Founding Engineer (CTO for the right person) | REMOTE (US), preference for Bay Area (tech), Chicago (consumer), or NYC (finance) | Full-time

Quin is an agentic platform to (finally!) solve personal finance for people. It is a consumer-focused company.

https://iamquin.ai

I spent 13 years in private banking and have been working on Quin alone for about 15 months. I built 6 different prototypes to test different approaches. I've spent the last few weeks working with testers on the latest version and solidifying GTM. I need someone to take over engineering with a focus on building the backend and data layers that will support our agentic approach to personal finance.

Georgetown. UCLA (MBA). Ex-JPMorgan.

Traction: Prototype with testers

The role: You're the first engineering hire. This is about shipping the workflows that will become the product that users will trust and the data layer that can support an agent in the future.

You'll own backend architecture decisions from day one. Contract-first development (TypeScript contracts repo as source of truth), FastAPI, Supabase/Postgres, Groq for LLM inference. The stack is clean and the codebase is small.

Who I'm looking for: A full-stack engineer with a preference for backend. 5+ years backend engineering; Python / FastAPI preferred. Strong data modeling instincts — you've designed schemas that had to scale. Experience with multi-tenant data architectures. Comfort operating without process. Finance domain familiarity a plus, not a requirement. Comfort and experience using AI tools and incorporating new ideas quickly.

For the right person, this is an opportunity to take a CTO/co-founder role and define the full technical path.

Comp: Salary post-raise and meaningful equity. TBH, finding this role (either version) will be important for rasisng capital given that I do not have a technical background and fintech is complicated by regulations. I'm ok with part-time in the meantime if that's what it requires.

Email quin@iamquin.ai with the primary reason this interests you and the top two reasons why you should be considered (don't worry about a resume at this point).

Comvex | Full Time | Multiple Roles | REMOTE (US, South America)

We're a healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM) technology company looking for our first set of full hires to help us build out our technology pipeline. RCM experience for these roles is a MUST.

The Roles:

Forward Deployment Engineer * EHR Integrations * Senior-level * 7+ years * 150-190K

Design and build EHR integrations across customer EHR platforms (e.x. Epic, Athena, ModMed, eClinicalWorks) via API (FHIR, HL7) or RPA/computer vision based integrations. Work directly with medical billing teams automate workflows and roll out deployments. Join discovery calls, onboarding sessions, technical troubleshooting, rollout and go live discussions. You MUST have EHR integration experience for this role.

Platform Engineer * AWS/Data Pipeline Experience * Senior-level * 6+ years * 140K-160K

Design, build, and expand our core task pipeline, and data infrastructure platform. Work with healthcare billing data (837, 835, 270/271), HL7 and FHIR data. Experience with data engineering and/or infrastructure engineering with some DevOps experience and a solid understanding of RCM processes is the type of person we're looking for here. We're AWS based cloud infra heavy leveraging a number of Python based Lambdas.

Full Stack Web Developer * Django, Next, Node * Mid-level * 4+ years * 110K-130K

A focus on automation of workflows and integration with 3rd party APIs. Hands-on experience with Playwright in production environments. Direct familiarity with clearinghouses (Change Healthcare, Availity, Waystar, or similar) and insurance payer portals. Full stack web dev experience building out reporting and dashboards mainly customer/internal.

IT Specialist * AWS Cloud + On Prem * Senior-level * 10+ years * 90-110K

Deep familiarity with Teams and Microsoft based cloud and on prem software. Hands-on AWS experience in practical administration of production cloud deployments. Strong troubleshooting instincts and comfort working independently. The ability to role up your sleeves and learn the best ways to configure, monitor and manage any application or service.

We just got our funding finalized and it's time to take our POC from a pitch into a full product. All roles are fully remote and open to anywhere in the USA or South America. Rates are dependent on experience and location.

Stack is mainly the same for all roles (Python, Django, OpenCV, Node, React, Claude). RCM experience for most roles is a must. Education needed is flexible. If you've got the proof to back up you can do the work that's what I'm interested in. Hours are flexible for most roles (forward deployment engineer will need to be available for most of a standard day's EST hours).

Email me at peter.lever@comvex.ai with what role you'd like to apply for and your CV if you're interested and we'll go from there.

Estuary | US-Based / Remote | Full-time – https://estuary.dev/

Estuary is a VC-backed, post–Series A startup powering right-time data replication and transform — from sub-second CDC replication to terabyte-scale OLAP data flows. We’re open-source, developer-first, and focused on making data movement radically simpler across both our Platform and Applications layers.

We’re hiring for:

Senior Systems Engineer — Capture & Materializations Design and build high-performance connectors that move data in and out of Estuary in real time. Work across APIs, databases, and streaming systems to ensure correctness, reliability, and scalability. This role is deeply systems-oriented, with a focus on data plane execution. Go and Rust are core to our stack.

Senior Systems Engineer — Control & Data Plane Own core infrastructure that orchestrates and powers Estuary’s runtime, from control plane services to distributed data processing systems. Tackle challenges in scaling, fault tolerance, and performance across a globally distributed system. Strong backend fundamentals required; Go and Rust experience preferred.

Senior Front-End Engineer Build highly interactive observability and data-flow experiences for the Estuary platform. Design and develop real-time visualizations of distributed data pipelines, metrics, and system health using React and TypeScript. We’re looking for engineers with deep front-end expertise, strong performance instincts, and experience building complex data visualization or developer-focused products.

Product Manager Own product areas end-to-end, working closely with engineering and design to shape the roadmap and deliver a great developer experience. Engage with users, translate real-world use cases into product decisions, and help define how modern data infrastructure should feel to build with.

Technical Product Marketing Manager Founding product marketing hire working closely with Estuary’s Head of Marketing and Developer Relations team. Help shape how we position and communicate the platform to technical audiences through product launches, messaging, technical content, demos, customer stories, and developer-facing campaigns.

What we’re looking for: Engineers who care about building reliable, maintainable systems and enjoy working with complex APIs and data flows. We value curiosity, clear communication, and a willingness to learn.

Bonus points for experience with CDC tools, open source contributions, or fast-paced startups.

To apply: Email your resume to careers@estuary.dev
